ns2:section.sectionText: Education and Development: A Case Study in Ecuador. This course explores the intersection of education and development and the role of NGOs in supplementing state-based education in Ecuador. The group serves their host community by offering an educational enrichment camp for the local children. Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. For more information, see: https://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/ On-campus meetings will begin the week of 3-11-13. Off-campus in Ecuador: tentatively the beginning of July to the beginning of August, 2013.
